description:
`profile show` prints the paths a package targets without per-target hash values, and per-target value hashing is removed; the package identity hash stays.

## Background

`ProfilePackageHashes::targets` (`crates/jit/src/profile/package.rs:910-971`) computes a hash per target. Its keys give the target set (`crates/jit/src/commands/profile.rs:2052`), and its values are printed by `profile show` (`crates/jit/src/profile/application.rs:149`), their only consumer. The resolved-content twin (`target_hashes`, `crates/jit/src/profile/variables.rs:466-505`) is read only for key presence (`crates/jit/src/repository_state/profile_apply.rs:1520,1560-1561`; `crates/jit/src/repository_state/initialize.rs:956-957`). Line numbers are at the investigation baseline.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `profile show` prints each package's target paths without per-target hash values.
- [hard] REQ-02: Per-target value hashing is gone from the package and variable-resolution modules, together with the private canonical-JSON helpers that served only that hashing.
- [hard] REQ-03: Target presence checks read the target set.
- [hard] REQ-04: The package identity hash of each shipped package is unchanged.
title: Show a package's target set without value hashes
